description: This script updates a sidebar markdown file by inserting a list of documentation links for API markdown files located in a specific directory. It searches for a section marker in the sidebar file and replaces its content with sorted links to the API docs, handling insertion if the section is missing.

methods.name: update_sidebar()
methods.description: Updates the '_sidebar.md' file by inserting sorted links to all markdown API files in the 'apis' directory, replacing the previous list or adding a new section if necessary.
